editorial.copyrightPolicy: Publisher article, review and press-release text is never copied; explained in Swoon'd's own words with a link to the original. Runway and editorial photography is never redistributed.

masteryModel.usefulCompetenceStatement: She can follow a conversation about what someone is wearing, a collection or a drop, name the shape or fabric being discussed, ask a real question about it, and say 'okay, I see why you love this' without faking expertise or judging anyone's body or budget.

licensingConstraints.constraint: Original vector illustrations and procedural garment flats only (license original-swoond); no runway, editorial, street-style or celebrity photos; no model likeness; garment flats are body-free.
No house, sneaker or streetwear logos in art; monogram patterns, signature checks, trade dress and iconic shoe outlines are not reproduced; names appear as text facts only.
No embedded runway or brand video; deep-link to official streams.
Never copy publisher, review or press-release text; paraphrase and link.
Curated calendar and appointment facts with source links; no resale-price data; no scraping of paywalled or restricted sites.
Designer and model names as facts only; no likeness, endorsement implication or fabricated quotes.
Cultural and religious dress taught respectfully, never as costume; SME review before release.

safetyConstraints: Body-neutral: describe garments, never bodies; no body-type prescriptions, weight or dieting talk, size guessing, or 'flattering' verdicts.
Budget-neutral: never shame any price point; price is not a quality proxy in any direction.
Resale and authentication scenarios cover scam risks generally (buyer protection, platform authentication) and never teach how to fake goods.
Vintage care stays generic; ask a professional for delicate pieces. No medical, allergy or skin claims (that is skincare).
Appropriation, representation and sustainability debates present multiple sourced positions; never coach confrontation.
Never encourage the learner to fake expertise or taste with the person they care about.
